Product information:
Product Overview
This men's double-breasted casual blazer is designed for spring and autumn, blending business formal with smart-casual style. Featuring a slim fit and non-iron finish, it offers a premium texture suitable for weddings and formal occasions.

Product Information
Material: Synthetic fiber blend (Main fabric), Polyester lining
Style: Smart Casual, Slim Fit
Features: Double-breasted design, Straight hem, Long sleeves, Regular length, Non-iron processing
Colour: White, Beige, Light Gray, Dark Gray, Black, Red, Army Green, Sky Blue, Royal Blue, Navy Blue, Purple, Wine Red, Lake Blue
Size Information:
Available Sizes: XXS, XS, S, M, L, XL, 2XL, 3XL
